use_case: AI resume screening and candidate ranking: scores each applicant 0-100 against the job order; auto-advanced Light Industrial applicants scoring 70 or more from 2025-09-15 to 2026-09-22
vendor_or_model: Third-party AI screening vendor (resume parsing and matching model) from the ATS marketplace
data_categories: Resumes; application answers; work history; certifications; prior ATS activity. No SSNs, I-9 data, consumer reports, or self-identification data
human_in_the_loop: Changed 2026-09-22: sort-only mode; recruiters review every applicant who meets the job order minimum requirements; no automatic advancement or rejection
applicable_laws: Title VII 703(a), (b), (k) (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); ADEA (29 U.S.C. 623(b)); ADA (42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6)); FCRA (15 U.S.C. 1681b) only if third-party data is added; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (vendor security). Not applicable while Florida-only: NYC LL 144; Colorado SB26-189
status: In production (sort-only since 2026-09-22); bias re-test due 2026-11-30

applicable_laws: Title VII 703(a), (b), (k) (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); ADEA (29 U.S.C. 623(b)); ADA (42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6)); Title VII 704(b) for job information; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); TCPA consent for texts (not analyzed here)
